pages.title: Primordial Charter
pages.text: A sheet of crystal on which the laws of physics are written as they were before any symmetry broke - one force, no masses, nothing yet decided. Reading it is like looking at the draft of a constitution that every later amendment has forgotten. Its edges are perfectly sharp.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hyperdimensional Reality kept rewriting me to fit its own laws. I wove axiom fragments and a source code fragment through a transfinite weave and pinned it with a reality anchor, hoping a copy of the original laws would remind the place who I was. It did.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.
